title: The sharp exponential rate of singularity for symmetric Bernoulli matrices
summary: OpenAI 数学仓库收录的研究手稿。展开查看英文摘要，或标记后让我进一步解释。

abstractEnglish:
Let An be a symmetric $`n\times n`$ matrix whose entries on and above the diagonal are independent uniform signs. We prove

$`\displaystyle \Pr(\det A_n=0)=\left(\frac12+o(1)\right)^n.`$
